clue.text: One who cannot see polish in game

parts.note: a blind man is one who cannot see; the possessive comes from reading the phrase as the blind man's polish
to buff is to polish

explanation.surface: A sightless person's shine features in some sport.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'One who cannot see polish' as 'a blind man's buff', the possessive supplying the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Blind man's buff is a children's party game in which a blindfolded player tries to catch the others.

clue.text: Feeling induced by bedroom frolics?

indicators.note: frolics suggests letters romping about, so the word bedroom is rearranged

explanation.surface: Ennui brought on by romping in the bedroom, the question mark teasing.
explanation.definitionFit: Boredom is a state of mind, a sense of weariness, so it is a kind of emotion.

clue.text: Things that happen when popular detectives get sent out

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of sent are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Events occur when well-liked police officers are dispatched.
explanation.definitionFit: Incidents are occurrences or events, things that take place.

clue.text: Exploits river deposits heartlessly

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

indicators.note: heartlessly says the middle of deposits is removed, keeping only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A river gains silt in an unfeeling way.
explanation.definitionFit: Exploits as a noun means feats or acts, which are synonyms of deeds.

clue.text: Look like dropping soldiers for a second get together

indicators.note: dropping says the soldiers are removed, with 'for' bringing in the replacement

parts.note: to look like is to resemble
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers
A plus S, the abbreviation for second

explanation.surface: Resemble a squad leaving, then briefly gather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' signals the swap: AS replaces RE at the start of RESEMBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble is to gather or come together as a group.

clue.text: Dress worn by footballers for big game trip

indicators.note: a garment worn by someone wraps around them, so the dress goes outside the footballers

parts.note: a sari is an Indian dress
FA is the Football Association

explanation.surface: Players in saris set off on a hunting holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A safari is an expedition to view or hunt large wild animals in Africa.

clue.text: Nice one, not sharp or flat, but abnormal

parts.note: un is French for one, as spoken in Nice
in music a natural note is neither sharp nor flat

explanation.surface: A pleasant individual, neither sharp nor flat in pitch, yet odd.
explanation.walkthrough: Nice is the French city, so 'Nice one' is French for one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnatural departs from what is normal, so it is aberrant.

clue.text: Father gets one on a run for brother

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
I is the Roman numeral one
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A priest takes a jog to visit his sibling.
explanation.definitionFit: A friar is a member of a religious order, addressed as Brother.

clue.text: Discovering mailbag has them horrified

indicators.note: discovering means exposing the letters lying within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Finding a postal sack containing them causes dismay.
explanation.definitionFit: Aghast means struck with shock and dismay, much like appalled.

clue.text: Noise made in front of son's 19

indicators.note: placed before the next piece in the answer

parts.note: a racket is a loud din
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A din coming from a boy's sporting contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 refers to the answer at 19-across, a ball game.
explanation.definitionFit: Rackets is a fast indoor court sport played with a hard ball, so it is an example of that.

clue.text: The Merry Monarch is lacking courage

parts.note: fun means jolly, merry
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Charles II, the Merry Monarch, is cowardly.
explanation.walkthrough: The Merry Monarch is a nickname for England's Charles II, which the surface trades on.
explanation.definitionFit: Funking means shirking or avoiding something out of fear, behaving timidly.

clue.text: American blokes investing energy in flops

indicators.note: investing means placing one thing within another

parts.note: duds are failures, flops
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Men in the US put vigour into failed ventures.
explanation.definitionFit: Dude is American slang for a man or guy.

clue.text: Delays speaker, taken in by target from the east

indicators.note: taken in means enclosed, so the speaker sits inside the target
in an across clue, from the east means read right to left

parts.note: an aim is a target
an orator is a public speaker

explanation.surface: A public speaker postpones things, absorbed by an aim from the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the east' reads the target backwards, and that reversed word wraps the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Moratoria is the plural of moratorium, a temporary suspension or postponement.

clue.text: Single technical college once achieving control of market

parts.note: mono means single or one
poly is short for polytechnic, a former type of British college

explanation.surface: One former college gains market dominance.
explanation.definitionFit: A monopoly is exclusive dominance of trade in a commodity by one supplier.

clue.text: Regularly permit church to register tariff

indicators.note: regularly says alternate letters of permit are taken

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a list is a register or roll

explanation.surface: Allow the church to enrol periodically.
explanation.definitionFit: A tariff is a schedule of charges, essentially a catalogue of costs.

clue.text: Very enthusiastic study in painting

indicators.note: in places the study within the painting

parts.note: painting is a form of art
a den is a private room for work, a study

explanation.surface: A keen study of a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent means passionate and fervent, full of zeal.

clue.text: Issue of people supporting English master

indicators.note: in a down clue a supporting piece sits below

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A people backing an English schoolmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: An emanation is something that issues or flows out from a source.

clue.text: City quiet after defender's adverse reaction

indicators.note: after places the city and quiet behind the defender

parts.note: a back is a defender in football
LA is Los Angeles
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A city falls silent after a defender's poor reaction.
explanation.definitionFit: A backlash is a strong hostile response to some event or change.

clue.text: Note covering Italian white wine drink

indicators.note: covering means one thing wraps the other, so the note encloses the wine

parts.note: PS is a postscript, a note added to a letter
Asti is a sparkling white wine from Italy

explanation.surface: A memo concerning Italian sparkling wine for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastis is an aniseed-flavoured French aperitif.

clue.text: A dangerous situation — beginning to play with fire

indicators.note: beginning to says only the first letter of play is used

parts.note: to light is to set fire to

explanation.surface: Playing with fire as the start of a hazard.
explanation.definitionFit: A plight is a predicament, a difficult or perilous state.

clue.text: Book everyone spirited enough for soccer, for example

parts.note: all means everyone
game means willing and plucky

explanation.surface: Booking all willing players for a football match.
explanation.definitionFit: Soccer is an instance of a sport played with a ball.

clue.text: Raise English tax in general

indicators.note: in places the tax within the general

parts.note: Robert E Lee was a US Confederate general
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: Raising English taxation across the board.
explanation.definitionFit: To elevate is to lift up to a higher position.

clue.text: Fire-raising by quiet man of the church

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
arson is deliberately setting fire to property

explanation.surface: A clergyman quietly commits arson.
explanation.definitionFit: A parson is a parish priest, a clergyman.

clue.text: Hate drink to be served without being informed

indicators.note: serving something up rearranges it, so the letters of hate and drink are reworked

explanation.surface: Disliking drink being served when you know nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the dark means being ignorant of the facts, unaware.

clue.text: People in blood group reported printing errors

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so what is said aloud sounds like the entry

parts.note: type Os are people with blood type O

explanation.surface: People with a certain blood type cited in misprints.
explanation.definitionFit: Typos are typographical mistakes, slips in setting text.

clue.text: Panic, seeing vehicle trapped in the London area

indicators.note: trapped in means held within, so the vehicle sits inside the area

parts.note: SE is the south-east, the region around London
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Alarm as a car is stuck in London's south-east.
explanation.definitionFit: A scare is a sudden fright or wave of alarm.

clue.text: Flesh wound from ledge

indicators.note: wound, read as twisted, says the letters of flesh are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gash in skin caused by a sill.
explanation.definitionFit: A shelf is a flat projecting ledge for holding things.

clue.text: People who like joints, eating pastry?

indicators.note: eating means taking something inside, so the joints enclose the pastry

parts.note: hips are joints of the body
a pie is a pastry dish

explanation.surface: Dope smokers consuming a pie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joints' serves both the definition (cannabis cigarettes) and the wordplay (body joints), a deliberate semi-all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: Hippies of the 1960s counterculture were associated with smoking cannabis.

clue.text: States where crime is rampant among non-drinkers

indicators.note: among puts the rearranged crime within the non-drinkers

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous

indicators.note: rampant means running wild, so the letters of crime are rearranged

explanation.surface: A country where crime runs wild among teetotallers.
explanation.definitionFit: The States is a common name for the United States.

clue.text: Chinese often have time off, and refuse to support either side

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Chinese people frequently take time out and stay neutral.
explanation.definitionFit: To sit on the fence is to avoid committing to either side of an argument.
